title: Walking in Power and Demonstration with Christ
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges believers to walk in the authority and power that God has given them, not just praying and asking for things but declaring and commanding God's word to come to pass. He draws on the example of Jeremiah, who was given the authority to root out, pull down, and build, and applies it to our lives today, encouraging us to be a place of hope, deliverance, and breakthrough in a broken world. Join Pastor Zehner as he ignites a fire in your heart to live a life of supernatural power and authority.
